column4: Pixel-art first-person sprite exactly like the hand and weapon sprites of a 1990s Build-engine game (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Redneck Rampage), matching the reference image's pixel size, palette, tan leather work gloves, grey rolled sleeves, brown beer bottle with the cream stag label, red lighter and shading. TRUE FIRST-PERSON VIEW from the player's own eyes. The same two hands opening the same bottle as in the reference, but BOTH forearms come UP FROM THE BOTTOM EDGE of the picture: the right forearm rises from the bottom right part of the bottom edge and its gloved hand grips the bottle in the lower middle; the LEFT forearm rises from the bottom LEFT part of the bottom edge, steeply, the grey sleeve touching the bottom edge, and its gloved left hand comes up to the top of the bottle holding the red lighter levered under the crown cap. Nothing touches the left, right or top edge of the canvas: the only thing cut off by the frame is the two sleeves, by the bottom edge. Both hands wear the same gloves. Chunky pixels, strong simple shading, low saturation. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere, no shadow, no text, no border, no watermark.

Pixel-art first-person sprite exactly like the two-handed weapon sprites of a 1990s Build-engine game (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Redneck Rampage), matching the reference image's pixel size, palette, tan leather work glove, grey rolled sleeve, brown beer bottle with the cream stag label and shading. TRUE FIRST-PERSON VIEW from the player's own eyes, looking down a little at the two hands in front of the chest, like holding a two-handed weapon. BOTH forearms enter the picture ONLY through the BOTTOM EDGE: the left forearm enters through the bottom edge at the left third of the picture and goes straight up and slightly right; the right forearm enters through the bottom edge at the right third of the picture and goes straight up and slightly left. They meet in the middle of the picture: the right gloved hand grips the beer bottle upright by its body, the left gloved hand above it holds a small red lighter levered under the bottle's crown cap. The left and right edges and the top edge of the picture stay EMPTY magenta: no arm, no sleeve, no hand touches them. Both sleeves are cut off flat by the bottom edge. Chunky pixels, strong simple shading, low saturation. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere, no shadow, no text, no border, no watermark.
